Original note: The rules an employer's contribution to an approved superannuation fund feeds (W-238e). No rule reads employer.fund for it in a condition. PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION adds up every employer contribution to a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund and charges the excess over its limit (S2 s.17(1)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vii); D-126); PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION charges the accretion on that excess (S2 s.17(1)(i); 1961 s.17(2)(viia); D-127). Neither reads employer.fund in a condition: EmployerContributionNode reaches both with every contribution (W-238e).
displayName: The employer's contribution to an approved superannuation fund

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.17(1)(h), (i): as PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION and PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION cite them
provenance.whatToCheck: Open Gazette 265620 at s.17(1)(h) and (i): confirm they take the employer's contribution to an approved superannuation fund, and that no other section of the Act takes it

terms.terms: The fund exists only to provide annuities: on retirement at or after a specified age, on incapacitation before retirement, or for widows, children or dependants on death. A beneficiary is entitled only to an annuity, of which at most one-third may be commuted where a gratuity is received, one-half otherwise. The fund's own rules govern within these bounds.
